note: Reported by the outgoing manager handoff (docs/claude/work/handoffs/2026-11-04-01AFoLuH-to-new.md, PR #23007): no funding settlement for bybit_2 in 24h. NOT re-measured live by this lane (no diag read of it exists -- that is the finding). DONE WHEN: (1) a Tier-1 read-only diag route returns the last N funding rows per account (funding_time, funding_usd, symbol) with the store's last-pulled-at and a read_state (measured / no_rows_in_window / not_pulled / unreadable, never 0); (2) bybit_2 is read through it and the 24h absence is confirmed (puller down vs venue settled nothing: Bybit settles every 8h, so >=3 settlements are expected per open perp per 24h) or refuted; (3) if puller down, restart/fix it (Tier 2 only for a service change). Rerun: diag route above, account bybit_2. 2026-11-05 lane: (1) route /api/diag/funding_settlements in PR #23446 (held for manager merge). (2) PARTIAL: existing bybit_wallet_truth?account_id=bybit_2&days=3&by_day=true (read 18:29Z) shows SETTLEMENT funding_usd on 11-03 (-0.0083), 11-04 (-0.0218), 11-05 (-0.0147) => 24h absence REFUTED at day granularity (puller delivering); per-settlement timestamps + last_pulled_at unproven until #23446 deploys. (3) no puller fix needed on this evidence; ict-trader-live/web-api active. 2026-11-05 ~20:00Z post-deploy read of /api/diag/funding_settlements?account_id=bybit_2 (route live; #23446 merged 87ec1261). MEASURED: settlements 11-04 16:00Z (SOL, ETH), 11-05 00:00Z and 08:00Z (ETH); 2 in last 24h; newest age 12.0h. Original claim (nothing settled in 24h) REFUTED. Literal <=8h criterion FAILS: no 16:00Z settlement though txn-log rows exist to 16:20Z => venue booked none, consistent with no open bybit_2 perp at 16:00Z, NOT verified. (b) exchange_funding (daily puller) newest row 11-03 08:00Z, last insert 11-03 08:27, while txn log has later SETTLEMENTs: that store lags ~2 days (feeds offline cost sweep funding attribution); timer active, cause not found.
